desc: 雾青幕布舞台承托旋转木马音乐盒，暖光透壳与细线图标讲清看点
leaf: 旋转木马造型音乐盒（穹顶盖带顶部旋钮与一枚正面端口、透明转鼓、内含旋转平台与三具悬挂平面木马、碗形底座带小足）
name: 雾幕舞台旋转木马音乐盒款

shots.intent: 详情页首屏把音乐盒拍成一座属于自己的小舞台：褶皱幕布加双层剪影山丘加圆台，一秒给出「旋转＋暖光」两个最大购买理由并承接搜索点击。
shots.textZone: headline above the curtain peaks on a #2F3A3F hairline underline rule, one support line beneath it, one right-aligned wide-tracked Latin eyebrow micro-label, one vertical three-dot marker

shots.intent: 先放大晚间床头的真实空档：一边是熄灯后什么也没有的台面，一边是同一机位亮起暖光的旋转木马，用画面对照代替任何功效话术。
shots.textZone: headline across the top band on a #2F3A3F hairline rule, one short label under each panel

shots.intent: 把源片那组四宫格卖点结构保留成可复用版式：一行标题加四枚细线圆图标，产品只做小体量锚点，让人三秒读完四个理由。
shots.textZone: headline above the icon row on a hairline rule, four short 12pt labels under the icon cells, one right-aligned eyebrow micro-label

shots.intent: 用同一只闭合盒子的三个转盘状态加一枚正俯视内切图，把「会转」这件核心事讲成可见的机制对照，而不是喊口号。
shots.textZone: headline above the row on a hairline rule, three short numbered labels beneath the three states, one caption inside the overhead inset

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实夜里的床头，让它自己的暖光当画面主光，用一件无字书锚定尺度，给买家一张可以代入的家用照片。
shots.textZone: one short bottom-band label over the throw area

shots.intent: 微距交代穹顶与顶部旋钮、正面凹槽端口的成型与壳体表面，把做工本身放进画面，替掉一切无法核实的口头承诺。
shots.textZone: one small solid accent chip at the lower corner holding a single short label

shots.intent: 侧面掠射交代透明鼓壁的真折射与内部平台边缘、木马剪影轮廓，让人相信这是一件封闭透壳玩具而不是贴纸。
shots.textZone: one hairline rule with a dot terminal running to a short label

shots.intent: 承接源片的产品参数屏结构，但四行数值全部留成卖家自填占位，用版式承担信任而不替卖家编造任何事实。
shots.textZone: headline above the frame, four left-aligned spec rows with generic field names, one right-aligned eyebrow micro-label

shots.intent: 把源片末尾的三档配色信息变成可选款画面：同款同光三座台，色号一律留占位由卖家按自家实拍填，一次完成选色。
shots.textZone: headline above the row on the curtain field, one short label under each podium, three swatch-ring labels

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口：暖光下的整机加一枚直角细线按钮，把看完十屏的犹豫转成一次明确点击，不靠促销喊话。
shots.textZone: headline and one support line in the right copy column on hairline rules, a square-cornered filled action button below them

style.iconSystem: single-weight 1.5pt line glyphs centred inside a thin #2F3A3F circle outline, no fill, no blob, no tile, laid out as a four-up grid with one short 12pt label under each; hairline callout rules ending in a dot terminal, #EFB971 reserved for the dot and the arrowhead only; no filled emblems, no seals, no certificate artwork, no QR codes

noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colour beyond #EFB971 and {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no rounded sticker lettering, no script, no filled or drop-shadowed headlines

style.presentationRules: the box always keeps the same case form and the same scale across screens: dome cap with its single top knob and its one dome-front recessed port, transparent drum wall, interior rotation platform on its centre column with the hanging flat figure silhouettes, bowl base with its small nub feet, all upright and in contact with the surface; the moulded shell is rendered as matte painted shell and the drum as true transparent wall with refraction and one specular streak, never as wood and never as brushed metal; no crank, key or winder is added because none is visible on the reference, and any real winder on a seller unit stays exactly where its own photo puts it; at least one overhead and one low camera in every set; no identifiable child or adult face and no hand anywhere; the lockText stored in styleLock.lockText is injected verbatim into every shot prompt through the {style_lock} placeholder and is never paraphrased
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster podiums #DCA79C and #E7BFAF on a matte #B6D5D1 stage floor; one matte #EFEAE6 bedside top with a folded #E7EFF0 knit throw in the single lifestyle screen; everything clean, dry and debris-free
style.typography: one high-contrast light geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; weight-300 headlines at 32-40pt in #2F3A3F on light fields or #FFFFFF over the curtain, each sitting on a #2F3A3F hairline underline rule; wide-tracked uppercase Latin eyebrow micro-labels at 11pt right-aligned; body lines 15-17pt, labels 12pt; all rendered copy carried only as short 「」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 45 characters
